ROA NATURE — BRAND ASSETS
=========================

These files are the official ROA NATURE brand artwork used by the site:

  logo-full.webp        Full logo (dark text) for light backgrounds
  logo-full-light.webp  Full logo (light text) for dark backgrounds
  logo-mark.webp        Standalone symbol
  favicon.png           Browser tab icon

The paths are configured in `src/data/site.js` under `assets`.
The header and footer use the full logo automatically.

To replace a logo, keep the same file name, or update the path in
`src/data/site.js`. Do not recolor, crop, redraw or alter the official files.
